summary: MannKind Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose that the FDA released it from a postmarketing requirement for Afrezza related to pulmonary malignancy risk, and provided updates on clinical trials. The filing contains no M&A, capital return, restructuring, or other special situation event. It is a routine regulatory and clinical update. The only remaining postmarketing requirement is a pediatric study, and a supplemental BLA for Afrezza in children has a PDUFA date of May 29, 2026. Data from the INHALE-1st study is expected in late 2027. No deal terms, advisors, or structural changes are mentioned.
